verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Paxos APIs for minting/redeeming existing stablecoins (mint.md, redeem.md) and payment flows, but nothing documenting a distinct 'issue your own branded stablecoin' program, its reserve-management practices, or the eligibility/gating requirements (e.g., minimum volume, regulatory vetting) stated honestly. Missing for 10: dedicated issuance-product docs, reserve/attestation disclosure, and explicit gating/eligibility criteria for founders wanting a new branded coin.
